attributes.action: Reform higher education to protect PhD candidates from harm
attributes.additional_details:
Increase phd salaries to be sufficient to cover living expenses
 Protect intellectual property of PhD students 
Transparency about complaints procedure in higher education  
Annual Review of tenured professors 
Robust university complaints procedure to protect the students from harm 
 Research integrity standards for academics and journals with intellectual property protection
Recognize PhD students who are accelerating research and give incentives to continue whilst protecting them from harm
attributes.background: PhD students are being employed at a voluntarily basis and not paid for the work they do. Often overlooked for publications and the credit are allocated to internal university scholars or to people who haven’t work at all.The complaints procedure is not transparent and protects the university

rejection.details: This is a matter for Universities and Higher Education Institutions.
